# mergeah_tool_pack_connectors (Resource)

Manage the entire connector membership of a Tool Pack. Destroy detaches all connectors from that Tool Pack. Do not combine with mergeah_tool_pack_connector resources for the same Tool Pack; their ownership conflicts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the provider as shown in examples/provider/provider.tf.
resource "mergeah_tool_pack_connectors" "example" {
  tool_pack_id = "a6d21b9d-6235-4f85-b175-0799fc4bfed1"
  connectors   = [{ slug = "linear", auth_scope = "INDIVIDUAL", tool_names = ["list_issues"] }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connectors` (Attributes List) Authoritative connector list. Omit tool_names to enable all tools; an empty tool_names list removes the connector. Do not manage this list with another resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connectors))
- `tool_pack_id` (String) Merge API field `tool_pack_id`. Changes require replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. See the Import section for its format.

<a id="nestedatt--connectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connectors`

Required:

- `slug` (String) Merge API field `slug`.

Optional:

- `auth_scope` (String) Merge API field `auth_scope`. Defaults to `INDIVIDUAL`.
- `tool_names` (Set of String) Merge API field `tool_names`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergeah_tool_pack_connectors.example 'a6d21b9d-6235-4f85-b175-0799fc4bfed1'
```
